classification.difficultyReason: Find the base angle from the given altitude with sin⁻¹, then use co-interior angles in the parallelogram.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of $\theta$ in this diagram. Answer to 1 d.p.

answer.worked:
Let $\alpha=\angle DAB$. In the right-angled triangle with the dashed line, opposite $=5$ and hypotenuse $=7$.
$$\begin{align*}\sin\alpha&=\frac{O}{H}\\\sin\alpha&=\frac{5}{7}\\\alpha&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{7}\right)\end{align*}$$
$AB\parallel DC$, so the interior angles on the same side of $AD$ sum to $180^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^{\circ}-\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{7}\right)\\\theta&\approx134.4^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
